name: Gibran Mourani
title: User Growth
bio: At MiniMax, Gibran Mourani works across both global business and user growth functions, with a current focus on driving user adoption of the company’s core AI models. After initially contributing on the global business side, building partnerships and identifying cross-market opportunities, he now works on user growth, where he develops and executes strategic marketing initiatives to scale product usage. His work centers on identifying high-leverage growth channels, designing go-to-market strategies, and optimizing user acquisition and activation funnels. By combining market insight with product understanding, he helps position MiniMax’s models for broader adoption across diverse user segments and global markets.
